title: Controlled spin-space embedding exercise
status_detail: First manuscript impurity warmup in planning. No spin-space exercise result or scientific interpretation has been produced or accepted.
objective: Exercise explicit mappings among spinless, spin-degenerate, collinear, and spinor finite state spaces before any impurity operators from material calculations are compared.
authorized_scope: Plan exact spin lifts, block orderings, Pauli-matrix spin mixing, unitary spin-frame changes, and structured mismatch failures.
Verify the Frobenius normalization identity for spin-independent lifted impurity operators and retain the comparison map.
Introduce complexity in the manuscript's fixed spinless, spin-degenerate, collinear, and spinor order.
completion_criteria: Every compared operator identifies its orbital and spin state space, dimension, ordering, frame, and mapping.
Exact lift, block, Hermiticity, normalization, and controlled-failure checks are executable from synthetic matrices.
Results establish only analytical or software/numerical verification of the controlled finite model.
exclusions: Matrices with unidentified or unequal state spaces are not directly subtracted.
No spin-orbit material model, DFT execution, scientific validation, or public API freeze is authorized.
A scalar model must fail explicitly when planted spin splitting or mixing is outside its declared class.
